checks: All validation/test metrics recompute from saved predictions to absolute tolerance 1e-10.
All 7 runs have identical sample IDs, movie IDs, class order, targets, and frame counts.
Learned runs have best/last checkpoints, exact reload flags, and selected validation KL matching training history.
Every run has saved validation/test per-class results.
Both E runs have checksum-verified, normalized attention maps aligned with every validation/test clip and its original frames; shared maps are exactly equal across reactions.

uncertainty_method.method: paired movie-cluster bootstrap; clip-weighted mean KL; percentile intervals
uncertainty_method.negative_difference: lower KL for the first model
uncertainty_method.limits: Test-sample uncertainty only, conditional on trained models. No training-seed variance or multiple-comparison correction. Shuffle uses one saved permutation per clip.
